Name: Joja Sasquatch and More
Author: StarandVeil
Description: Players can decorate their homes with a Joja version of Sasquatch/Big Foot/Dark Creature/asldkfjsquaskutanfsldk and statues from Leah's 8 heart event. These only appear after players have earned 8 hearts with Leah. There are no cutscenes, letters, or anything else in this mod. Just furniture. Furniture from this mod can be obtained from the Joja Catalogue.

Manifest.Name: Joja Sasquatch and More
Manifest.Description: A small collection of Joja themed statues and sculptures.
